title: Combine Intervals

content.problemStatement: You receive an array of `intervals` where `intervals[i] = [starti, endi]`, merge all overlapping intervals, and output *an array of the non-overlapping intervals that cover all the intervals in the input*.
content.inputFormat: Single line: JSON array of all arguments, e.g. [arg1, arg2, ...]
